gallery.description:
Journeyman Linemen from Bluestem Electric Cooperative build a new electric service for a new home outside of Olsburg, Kansas. 
This Rural Development investment is part of an investment to build 30 miles of line, improve 44 miles and make other system improvements. The loan amount includes $144,000 for smart grid projects. 
Bluestem Electric is headquartered in Wamego, which serves 5,542 residential consumers, 1,364 commercial consumers and 201 irrigation systems. 
Bluestem operates and maintains 3,000 miles of line in 11 counties.

USDA Photo by Preston Keres
